upstreamOwnerActionsToClear.action: On a protected identity, independently qualify and admit an exact currently selectable marketing-smb-v1 release (selectable=true, governed admission performed) with immutable digests, or publish an explicit retirement that names the replacement first-website provider. Historical WP-0 candidate_nonselectable receipts are insufficient.

Admit a current Master Website Template release with current.json production pointer, catalogue/governance/release-receipt selectability selectable, admission performed, and independent qualification receipts bound to that protected commit/tree covering A1/A2/A3 plus A/B/C/L. Draft candidate handoffs and EXT-LS pending gates are not admission.
Re-run LSG0-03 against the new exact protected commit/tree. Do not mutate LiNKlibraries from LiNKsites.
